name: claude-ops
description: Claude Code mods for keeping an eye on usage limits and which models your agents run on, and for keeping subagents small

plugins.name: usage-limits
plugins.description: Keeps the 5-hour and weekly limit windows, reset countdowns, context fill and session cost pinned under the prompt

plugins.name: session-models
plugins.description: Shows the main model and its effort, and the live agents (main thread, subagents, in-process teammates) by model and effort

plugins.name: subagent-limits
plugins.description: Tells the main agent how to size and split work, asks a growing subagent to checkpoint, and refuses its tools past a hard limit so a fresh agent takes over

plugins.name: workflow-audit
plugins.description: Audits how you use Claude Code from your own transcripts and writes a blunt report: where your spend and rework go, checked against dated advice, with one experiment per finding

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: Gives every editing agent its own git worktree from your current commit, stops what agents leave running, removes each agent's worktree once you merge it, and tidies the rest with /tidy

plugins.name: kit
plugins.description: Sets a project up from its actual code: conventions, lint and test hooks, a review checklist and agents with fixed models; revises it later from real sessions

plugins.name: truss
plugins.description: Runs a big goal as parallel crews of engineering-role agents: each crew's foreman delegates to your project's agents in its own worktree, a QC engineer checks the work, and the crews merge one at a time or as one PR
